Axiom:
**In `extend-dag`, existing Task-IDs and ticket files are immutable.**
- New tasks get next sequential `TSK-NN` after max existing. - Existing tickets are NOT regenerated even if upstream specs changed — that is the orchestrator's reopen scenario via `sdd-execute`, not regeneration. - `add-scope` upstream → scaffold only for the new scope. - `add-module` or `refine-module` upstream → scaffold only for the new/changed surface; unchanged-surface tickets untouched. - Per-scope Cascade Table may update; existing tickets keep their old per-phase `Rules:` lists — orchestrator re-derives on reopen if the operator opts in. - DAG edges/IDs preserved; new tasks appended.
